title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.26627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. translated_title: 扩散Transformer中的强化学习后训练本质上是激活导向
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练能显著提升扩散Transformer的视觉质量、文字渲染和组合准确性。由于诸如渲染指定文本或组合多个对象等能力本质上依赖于提示词，一个自然的假设是：提升这些能力需要学习复杂的、依赖于输入的变换。为了探究这些收益中有多少可以由一个与输入无关的偏移来解释，我们用一种刻意简单的参数化方式来探测每个经RL调优的模型：在冻结的基础模型的块输出上添加一组固定的导向向量。在SD3.5-M上，这些向量的参数量比RL调优后的LoRA少65倍（0.29M对比18.8M）。我们拟合这些向量以匹配公开RL调优检查点的速度预测，目标函数中不含任何奖励信号。尽管这些向量对每个提示词、每个token和每个采样种子都是完全相同的，它们仍然恢复了六个RL后训练模型90.0–96.3%的奖励收益（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现扩散Transformer的强化学习后训练收益可以用一组与输入无关的固定导向向量（参数量仅为LoRA的1/65）复现90%以上，证明RL后训练本质上等价于简单的激活导向。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the gains of RL post-training in diffusion transformers can be largely reproduced (90.0-96.3%) by a fixed set of input-independent steering vectors with 65x fewer parameters, demonstrating that RL post-training is essentially activation steering.
